cases.name: intersect-partial
cases.note: Two 4-cubes offset 2 on X overlap on x in [0,2]: 2*4*4 = 32.

cases.name: intersect-contained
cases.note: A 2-cube fully inside a 4-cube: the overlap is the 2-cube itself, 8.

cases.name: intersect-identical
cases.note: Identical 4-cubes: the overlap is the whole cube, 64.

cases.name: intersect-disjoint
cases.note: Tool 10 units away on X: no shared volume, named empty result csg-empty-result.

cases.name: intersect-touching-face
cases.note: 2-cubes sharing only the x=1 face plane: zero shared volume, named empty result — never a zero-volume brush.

cases.name: intersect-shared-face-coplanar
cases.note: Overlap shares the big cube's +X face plane (x=2): 2*2*2 = 8, one clean 6-face box after coplanar merge on output.

note: Acceptance cases for hammer-csg-intersect. All boxes are axis-aligned and centred on the origin unless toolOffset moves the tool; volumes are in Geppetto Desktop kernel units (inches, Z-up). The mapcsgintersect test group recomputes every case from this file. Cases with "empty": true expect TryIntersect to refuse with reason csg-empty-result and no mesh — disjoint, or merely touching, solids share no volume.
